item.content:encoded:
Nice concept, well done, upvoted.

That said, I end up being a bit curious on the timing. It says the time between instances grows as new ones appear. Looking at the timeline we go 1994, 1995, 1997, 2000, 2014, 2019, 2025.

So that's +1, +2, +3, +14, +5, +6.

Iiiiiiis that SUPPOSED to be +14? Or was that a mixup and you meant to do +4? Because I don't see why the Foundation would predict the next instance would appear in 2019 if the pattern failed to remain consistent.

JUST CHECKING.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I think you are missing the point, he's not complaining that you got too creative with the format, he's complaining that you basically just added the infamous (and defunct) HSAS to the Foundation (or at least in that's how it looks in English). Codenames, place-sensitive alphanumerics, or really anything else would have been less cliché.

There's a reason why I introduced Greek Letter-Color prioritisation to the Centreverse in SPC-140 and it's because I wanted that B-Grade knockoff spythriller feel, for the B-Grade knockoff universe.

Is there some reason that color coded threat levels in French aren't as cliché and narmy as they are when translated into English?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I'm still not in love with this whole "Threat Level" thing. Like, "Threat Level: Black ●" is such a typical passe shadowy-organization thing, you could slot it into anything from an Argent Energy database to an Umbrella Corporation memo and it wouldn't look out of place for a second. Hell, the Safe/Euclid/Keter system almost felt like a subversion of that whole trope.
